title: Red Hat Security Advisory: opentelemetry-collector security update
description: Multiple denial of service vulnerabilities and a man-in-the-middle vulnerability were identified in the Red Hat build of OpenTelemetry Collector components, primarily related to golang libraries such as net/http, crypto/tls, net/textproto, and crypto/x509. These issues allow denial of service via crafted HTTP Range headers, excessive HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames, memory limit bypass in multipart parsing, and multiple ECH outer extension references, as well as man-in-the-middle attacks via untrusted intermediate certificates. Red Hat has released security updates addressing these vulnerabilities in OpenTelemetry Collector packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.4 variants.
